note: The engineering library (0.8 Track CE, CE.4; docs/0.8-PART3.md). Textbook formulas as readable CraftScript, SI units, every result with its source. Each file's header gives Usage, Method, Units, Limits, References and Check (tools/field-test/eng.mjs). The unit table and the property data are builtins (cs-lib-eng.js).

items.name: reynolds
items.summary: the Reynolds number of a flow in a duct

items.name: hydraulic_diameter
items.summary: the diameter of a round pipe that behaves like a duct of any shape

items.name: friction_factor
items.summary: the Darcy friction factor of flow in a duct, laminar to fully turbulent

items.name: darcy_weisbach
items.summary: the pressure drop of flow along a duct

items.name: minor_loss
items.summary: the pressure lost at a bend, valve, tee, sudden change or entrance

items.name: pipe_flow
items.summary: mass flow through a round pipe: velocity, Reynolds number, friction factor, pressure drop

items.name: rect_channel
items.summary: flow in a straight rectangular channel: velocity, Reynolds number, friction factor, pressure drop

items.name: nusselt_dittus_boelter
items.summary: the Nusselt number of turbulent flow in a smooth tube (simple, for first sizing)

items.name: nusselt_gnielinski
items.summary: the Nusselt number of turbulent and late-transition flow in a tube

items.name: nusselt_tube
items.summary: the Nusselt number of flow in a round tube, laminar or turbulent, with the correlation named

items.name: htc
items.summary: the heat transfer coefficient from the Nusselt number

items.name: fin_efficiency
items.summary: the efficiency of a straight rectangular fin, and the heat it gives

items.name: lmtd
items.summary: the log mean temperature difference of a heat exchanger

items.name: effectiveness
items.summary: the effectiveness of a heat exchanger from its NTU and capacity ratio

items.name: ntu_for
items.summary: the NTU a heat exchanger needs for a given effectiveness

items.name: hx_size
items.summary: the size (UA) a heat exchanger needs to move a given heat, by the epsilon-NTU method

items.name: allowable_stress
items.summary: the stress a part may carry, from the material's strength and a safety factor

items.name: wall_thin_cylinder
items.summary: the wall a thin-walled pipe or cylinder needs against internal pressure

items.name: barlow
items.summary: the wall of a pipe from its outside diameter (Barlow's formula)

items.name: wall_thick_cylinder
items.summary: the wall a thick-walled cylinder needs against internal pressure (Lame)

items.name: wall_sphere
items.summary: the wall a thin spherical shell needs against internal pressure

items.name: isentropic
items.summary: the isentropic flow ratios of a perfect gas at a Mach number

items.name: mach_from_area
items.summary: the Mach number at a given area ratio in a nozzle

items.name: choked_flow
items.summary: the mass flow through a nozzle throat at sonic speed, and the throat area for a mass flow

items.name: throat_area
items.summary: the throat area that passes a given mass flow at sonic speed

items.name: exit_mach
items.summary: the Mach number a nozzle reaches expanding from a stagnation pressure to an exit pressure

groups.label: Check loop: stress, temperature and flow on a generated part

items.name: check_stress
items.summary: the stress in a generated part under loads, by PartCraft's voxel stress solver

items.name: check_thermal
items.summary: the temperatures in a generated part with fixed temperatures and heat input, by PartCraft's thermal solver

items.name: check_flow
items.summary: how much a channel network resists a flow, by PartCraft's lattice Boltzmann solver, on one periodic cell
